title: ソーラン節 (Soran Bushi — The Soran Song)
description: A powerful traditional work song (民謡) from the herring fishermen of Hokkaido, Japan's northernmost island. The distinctive 'ヤーレン ソーラン ソーラン' refrain echoed across the cold sea as fishermen hauled in their massive herring nets. Today it is performed as a vigorous folk dance at festivals and school sports days across Japan, and regional high school groups compete in elaborately choreographed 'Soran Dance' performances.
license: Public Domain (Traditional Japanese minyo folk song from Hokkaido, origins in Edo/Meiji period fishermen's work songs)
